runs.note: The initially blank same-capacity candidate was created by exclusive open and truncate; this run did not record an initial full-image hash or allocated-byte field. QMP query-nodes request counters were zero but wr_highest_offset increased. Complete 4KiB workload records in independent wrong.raw prove writes to a different disk under duplicate presented identity.
runs.configuration: defaults { allow_usb_devices yes; find_multipaths strict; polling_interval 1; max_polling_interval 4; path_checker tur; detect_prio no; prio const; path_selector "round-robin 0"; no_path_retry 8; flush_on_last_del no; recheck_wwid yes; user_friendly_names no; } blacklist { wwid ".*"; } blacklist_exceptions { property "^ID_SERIAL$"; wwid "0QEMU_QEMU_HARDDISK_UPSTREAM-SCSI-001"; } multipaths { multipath { wwid "0QEMU_QEMU_HARDDISK_UPSTREAM-SCSI-001"; alias probe; } }
runs.configuration_note: Semicolons here separate lines for display; generated multipath.conf uses newlines. wwids file contains only the enrolled WWID. Exact template is in probe source.

independent_readonly_audit.method: Read allocated sparse file extents with inspect_sparse_records, then os.pread matching 4096-byte offsets on opposite backing file; no guest or host block devices used.

debug_setup_failures.cause: BusyBox modprobe cannot load compressed module; corrected to /sbin/modprobe.
Runtime pthread_cancel dependency libgcc_s.so.1 missing from ldd-only closure; added explicitly.
Default udev property allowlist does not accept this QEMU identity; added explicit ID_SERIAL property allowlist restricted by WWID.
Plain scsi_id formatting differs from exported ID_SERIAL; enrollment now uses same exported property as daemon.

notes: Each run uses fresh regular files, no host disks, RAM root, no Guard, and a data LV; no full Ubuntu root deployment proof.
VmLck is the reported virtual locked-mapping quantity, not a physical RAM usage sum; no cause attributed.
The published script evolved between runs to add flags/evidence extraction; each original script hash and actual guest payload hash are recorded.
Verification uses posix_fadvise(POSIX_FADV_DONTNEED) plus ordinary read, not O_DIRECT and not a power-loss durability test.
The normal-scheduler run removes CAP_SYS_NICE but does not impose a CPU quota.
Scheduler values were observed for main daemon PID; source has only one scheduler change site; all-thread scheduler sampling is still a follow-up.
